name: Required Reason: file timestamps
plain: iOS file creation and modification time needs a reason code: C617.1, 3B52.1, DDA9.1 or 0A2A.1.
meaning: File dates can reveal install time and OS age. Reasons limit who sees them: C617.1 app container, 3B52.1 user-granted files, DDA9.1 display, 0A2A.1 SDK wrapper.

android.api_surface: Android has no gate; File.lastModified is open

ios.revocation: App Review: reason must match use
ios.api_surface: C617.1 app, app group or CloudKit container; 3B52.1 user-granted files; DDA9.1 show to user (no off-device send); 0A2A.1 SDK wrapper only

limits.headline: Can check file dates on iPhone only with a stated reason, and freely on Android
limits.user_action: Nothing. The app checks when it opens or syncs
can: Check dates on its own files, app group files or CloudKit files on iPhone
Check dates on files you chose to give it
Show you file dates inside the app
Check dates on Android with no gate
cannot: Check dates on iPhone without one of the listed reasons
Send the dates off your phone when the reason is only to show you
Use the dates for tracking, under the rules
limits.reach_label: A number, with a stated reason
limits.differs: Android has no gate. iPhone requires a declared reason such as C617.1 or DDA9.1.

story.what_it_is: iOS makes apps give an approved reason before reading file dates.

marketing.name: Required Reason APIs
marketing.pitch: Developer rule: apps must declare why they read file creation or modification time, since dates can fingerprint a device.

story.for_you: You never see it. File dates can reveal when you installed an app or updated the system, so Apple makes apps explain why they read them.
story.for_makers: Makers choose a reason code, like C617.1 for their own files or 3B52.1 for files you shared. Using dates for tracking is not allowed.

use_cases.example: A notes app sorts documents by last edited date and declares C617.1.
A files app shows the date of a document you opened and declares 3B52.1.
A toolkit wraps file dates for the app and declares 0A2A.1.
A viewer app shows the date a file was made and declares DDA9.1.
A tracker SDK that reads install time through file dates is flagged.
A fraud tool that reads file dates to guess phone age loses access.

story.ios_note: Enforced through the privacy manifest and App Store checks.
